title: UpKeep Status Colours Deck
project: UpKeep Command Center: drafts yellow, confirmed green, alerts red
example_data: All app screens are rendered HTML mockups with made-up SAMPLE data (recipient "Robin", .example stores).

pairs.ask: Which yellow for drafts and to-do?

optionA.label: Saffron
optionA.desc: Warm deep yellow, sits well with terracotta.

optionB.label: Butter
optionB.desc: Soft light yellow fill behind the row.

optionA.label: Jungle
optionA.more: Same green as "running" in the footer.

optionA.label: Signal red
optionA.desc: A true red, used only for alerts.
optionA.more: Never confused with terracotta brand accents.

optionB.label: Terracotta red
optionB.more: More on-brand, closer to the accent colour.

pairs.ask: How does a row show its status?

optionA.label: Left edge
optionA.desc: A thin coloured edge on the row.

optionB.label: Dot before the name
optionB.more: Even quieter; colour as a hint.

pairs.ask: Do we show what the colours mean?

optionA.label: Tiny key in the header
optionA.desc: "● to do ● confirmed ● alert" once at the top.
optionA.more: New people learn it in a second.

pairs.ask: How does the Machan mark sit in the header?

optionA.label: On a small cream tile
optionA.desc: Mark on a rounded cream square.

optionB.label: On its own
optionB.desc: Just the mark beside the title.

optionA.label: One alert red, icon per hazard
optionA.desc: Red for every alert; a small icon says water, power, gas.

optionB.label: Own colour per hazard
optionB.desc: Water blue, power orange, gas purple.
optionB.more: Faster to tell apart, breaks the three-colour rule.

pairs.ask: What does the closed Done fold say?

optionB.label: Count plus last ticked
optionB.more: Tells you what just happened without opening.

pairs.ask: When does the slim header show?

optionA.label: Always past the header
optionA.desc: Sticks once you scroll past the big header.
optionA.more: Back link and status always in reach.

optionB.label: Only scrolling up
optionB.desc: Hides scrolling down, returns scrolling up.

pairs.ask: What colour is the "Needs Max" box?

optionA.label: Yellow (it is a to-do)
optionA.desc: Follows the new rule: waiting on you = yellow.

optionB.label: Lagoon blue
optionB.desc: A calm blue box, separate from status colours.
optionB.more: Stands apart from the three-colour rule.

pairs.ask: Open alerts on a closed fold?

optionA.label: Red count badge
optionA.desc: A small red "2" on the fold.

optionB.label: Red edge on the fold
optionB.desc: The fold gets a red edge, no number.
optionB.more: Quieter, matches your Terracotta Edge pick.
